description: The Soma package registry — a sparse HTTP index. soma add <name> resolves GET /<name>.json.

packages.name: matrix
packages.description: numpy-style linear algebra: inverse, solve, lstsq, arange, stacking, statistics, elementwise lambdas.

packages.name: money
packages.description: Amounts in minor units with their currency: no Float holds money.

packages.name: time
packages.description: Unix seconds to a civil date and time in a zone and back, with daylight saving; ISO 8601 in and out.

packages.name: auth
packages.description: JSON Web Tokens (HS256) and signed webhook payloads, in pure Soma on `hmac_sha256` and `secure_eq`.

packages.name: ratelimit
packages.description: Fixed windows and token buckets kept in the cell's persistent memory: they survive a restart, and since a handler is atomic two requests never both take the last slot.

packages.name: queue
packages.description: Durable jobs with claim / acknowledge: a claimed job is invisible for a while and handed out again if its worker dies; after too many deliveries it is parked as dead.

packages.name: text
packages.description: Words, sentences, n-grams, edit distance, and a line diff.

packages.name: vector
packages.description: Similarity search over embeddings, and a local embedding that needs no model.

packages.name: http_client
packages.description: Retries with backoff and pagination over `http_get` / `http_post`.
